name: darkraise
description: Darkraise's collection of Claude Code plugins.

plugins.name: dcc-telegram-notify
plugins.description: Push a Telegram message when a Claude Code session finishes a turn, ends on a question, or needs your attention. Cross-platform, multi-account aware, optional LLM summaries.

plugins.name: dcc-superpower-companions
plugins.description: Extends superpowers with 16 model and effort tiered implementer subagents, a four-axis task scoring rubric, and a defined escalation ladder.

plugins.name: dcc-statusline
plugins.description: A Claude Code status line: git detail, model and session state, plus context and rate-limit meters colored by usage level, framed in the color of the Claude account the session belongs to.
